questions.prompt: What should each stock-stack entry contain?

choices.label: Only the price, with every entry counted as one day.
choices.feedback: One entry can summarize several consecutive days that were already combined.

questions.prompt: Which earlier prices can join today's span?

choices.label: Consecutive prices less than or equal to today's price.
choices.feedback: The span includes equal prices but stops at the first earlier higher price.

choices.label: Only prices strictly less than today's price.
choices.feedback: The span includes equal prices but stops at the first earlier higher price.

choices.label: Every lower price in history, even across a higher price.
choices.feedback: The span includes equal prices but stops at the first earlier higher price.
